comparison.objective: Move all crackers to a basket while excluding a desiccant packet.
comparison.physical_skill: Object classification, repeated pick-and-place, and handling stacked small items.
comparison.success_condition: All six crackers are released and stable in the basket; any packet entry permanently scores zero.
comparison.reason: The task is semantic sorting with exclusion, not precision mating or preservation of rolling elements during a constrained mechanical transfer.
